root_cause.text: The function `mt7996_mac_write_txwi_80211()` accesses management frame fields (`mgmt->u.action.category` and `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code`) without first validating that the skb contains sufficient data, allowing out-of-bounds memory access on abnormally short frames.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a frame length check `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1` before accessing the nested `mgmt->u.action` structure fields. Without this check, a malformed or truncated action frame could have insufficient data in the skb buffer, causing the code to read beyond the allocated frame data when dereferencing the action category and ADDBA request fields.
